metadata.title: पूर्वोत्तर राज्यों का हक़ दे सरकार - प्रद्योत किशोर | North East need land rights - Pradyot Kishor
metadata.description: Pradyot Kishore Manikya, a prominent leader from the Northeast, has been making frequent trips to Delhi, where he is engaged in high-level meetings with senior government ministers of India, including Home Minister Amit Shah. In an exclusive interview with Shyam Sunder, Editor of Main Bhi Bharat, Pradyuo revealed the core agenda of his discussions. He is striving to unite the leaders of the northeastern states to collectively exert pressure on the central government to address and fulfil the long-standing demands of the region. His efforts underscore the importance of a unified front in advocating for the rights and development of the northeastern states.
